RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the March 3, 2008/Phalguna 13, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Law
and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Women and Child
Development)
Total number of questions — 20
20
Setting up of Disability
Rehabilitation Centres
in Madhya Pradesh
†*61. SHRIMATI MAY A SINGH: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
proposal for setting up of Disability
Rehabilitation Centres for the disabled
persons in every district;
(b) whether these Centres have been
set-up in only 17 districts of Madhya
Pradesh till date and if so, by when the
permission for setting up these Centres in
the remaining districts would be given; and
(c) by when the financial assistance/
grant would be sanctioned for setting up
sufficient number of these Centres keeping
in view that there are 14 lakh disabled
persons in the State and the present
arrangement is inadequate for them?
Power crisis
*62. DR. ABHISHEK MANU
SINGHVI: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
many States in the country are facing a
major power crisis which, in turn, is
hampering their development in a major
way;
(b) if so, what efforts are being made in
co-ordination with the affected State
Governments to rectify the situation;
(c) whether a time frame has been set to
address the problem; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Tribal rights to forest land
*63. SHRI O. T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the rules and regulations
pertaining to tribal rights to forest land have
since been framed and notified and the
relevant Act of Parliament brought into
force;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
details of new policy guidelines issued in
this regard; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

21
(c) since when the same have been
enforced?
Setting up of Supreme Court and
High Court Bench in Andhra
Pradesh
*64. SHRIMATI N. P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Andhra
Pradesh Legislative Council has requested
for setting up of a Bench of Supreme Court
in Hyderabad;
(b) whether it has also requested for
setting up a Bench of High Court in coastal
Rayalaseema region of the State; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the action
contemplated by Government on these
requests?
Swadhar Shelter Homes Scheme
*65. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of WOMEN
AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the objective and genesis of Swadhar
Shelter Homes Scheme;
(b) the progress/achievements thereof
till date, particularly in Rajasthan; and
(c) the number of widows, divorced,
separated women, both in rural and urban
areas, rehabilitated, out of 342.90 lakh
widowed women and 23.43 lakh divorced
or separated women in the country, as per
2001 census?
Reservation benefits to dalit
christians and muslims
*66. PROF. P. J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether dalit christians and muslims
have asked for reservation benefits;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reaction of Government to their
demand?
Social security policy for minorities
*67. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is actively
considering to introduce a social security
policy for the families of minorities,
particularly muslims, living below poverty
line and the lower middle class, and also for
those who are mentally retarded and
physically disabled;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it is expected to be introduced;
(c) how far the minorities are expected
to be benefited; and
(d) the States where it would be
introduced first and by when in Uttar
Pradesh?
Establishment of IIM in Andhra
Pradesh
*68. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Andhra Pradesh
Government has proposed to his Ministry
to establish Indian Institute of Management
at Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh, in
view of the fact that this city has a major
port and houses numerous big private and
public sector companies;
(b) if so, the details and status of the
proposal;
(c) the reasons for delay in sanctioning
it; and

22
(d) by when it is likely to be given
clearance?
UNESCO report on literacy
*69. SHRIMA TI SUPRIYA SULE:
SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the UNESCO report has
rapped the country for its poor literacy
record and on the basis of the population
growth, the UNESCO Institute of Statistics
has projected that the country's literacy
rate is just a shade over 60 per cent,
compared with global standards, and that
one-third of world's illiterates live in the
country;
(b) if so, whether the Ministry has
added that it would not be able to achieve
85 per cent literacy by 2012 and blamed
the National Literacy Mission for the
failure as it did not target illiterates above
35 years and caters only to the 15-35 age
group; and
(c) if so, what are the steps Government
proposes to take in this regard?
Proposal of West Bengal for funds for
renewable energy programmes
*70. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY: Will
the Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE
ENERGY be pleased to refer to answer to
Unstarred Question 1403 given in the
Rajya Sabha on the 3rd December, 2007
and state the reasons for non-acceptance
of the proposal of Government of West
Bengal?
Development charges in private
colleges
*71. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that private
colleges are taking a large amount of fees as
development charges, etc.;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government is making any
law for filling up maximum seats through
UGC; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Rural electrification in Rajasthan
†*72. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has fixed any
target for the electrification of all the villages
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) the number of villages in Rajasthan
which are to be electrified during 2008 and
by when all the villages in Rajasthan are
likely to be electrified, the details thereof?
Environmental clearances for UMPPs
*73. DR. K. KESHAV A RAO: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) how many Ultra Mega Power
Projects (UMPPs) have been proposed by
various parties in the country;
(b) what is their total capacity;
(c) whether inordinate delay, in granting
environmental clearances, is hampering the
implementation of these projects; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

23
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) if so, whether there is any proposal
with Government to prepare a
comprehensive environmental mapping to
hasten such clearances?
Malnutrition in Vidarbha region
†*74. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has prepared
any project to save thousands of tribal and
other category children of Vidarbha region
in Maharashtra from malnutrition;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that, on many
occasions, young children have even died
due to malnutrition; and
(d) if so, the effective steps taken by
Government to avoid recurrence of such
incidents?
Funds to Bihar under RGGVY
*75. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds being made
available to Bihar under Rajiv Gandhi
Grameen Vidyutikaran Yojana (RGGVY)
during the last two financial years;
(b) the utilization percentage of the
allocated amount;
(c) whether the utilization of the funds
is according to the Scheme as envisaged in
the Budget; and
(d) how many villages are yet to be
covered under the Scheme and what is the
time frame for this?
Objectionable comments in textbooks
of Delhi University
†*76. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that objectionable
comments on History and Hindu Gods and
Goddesses have been made in the text-
books of Delhi University;
(b) whether any agitation is also going
on against it; and
(c) whether there is any proposal to
make improvement in the textbooks?
Misuse of funds under Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan
†*77. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
any information regarding misuse of funds
by States under the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the funds misused
during the last three years, State-wise; and
(d) the necessary action taken by
Government to prevent such misuse and
not to allot funds to the States?
Schemes for SC and ST students
*78. SHRI M. V . MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is sponsoring various schemes through

24
State Governments to enable the Scheduled
Caste and Scheduled Tribe students to
pursue their education;
(b) if so, the details of the schemes and
the funding pattern thereof and the funds
released during 2005-06 and 2006-07;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
implementation of the schemes has failed
in the States due to improper planning,
inefficient budgeting, poor supervision, etc.
especially in Andhra Pradesh; and
(d) if so, the details of action taken by
Government in this regard?
Delimitation of Constituencies
*79. SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Delimitation
Commission has completed the work of
delimitation of Assembly and Parliamentary
Constituencies;
(b) if not, the States in which the
process has been completed and the States
in which the process is incomplete;
(c) whether notification(s) with respect
to any State(s) have been laid on the Table
of the House; and
(d) by when the notifications are likely
to come into force?
Private participation in power and
energy sectors
*80. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of NEW AND
RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether according to report by
KPMG and CII, a conducive policy and
regulatory framework is necessary to
attract private participation in the
country's power and upstream energy
sectors, which would require an investment
of up to $150 billion over the next five
years;
(b) if so, whether Government has
considered the report;
(c) if so, the main points mentioned in
the report; and
(d) the steps being taken to improve
the renewable energy in the country?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 26th February, 2008 Secretary-General.
Phalguna 7, 1929 (Saka)

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Food Processing Industries :—
Human Resource Development : 68, 69, 71, 76, 77,
Law and Justice : 64, 79,
Mines :—

New and Renewable Energy : 70, 80,
Power : 62, 72, 73, 75,
Social Justice and Empowerment : 61, 78,
Tribal Affairs : 63,
